summary: Your 39 units of coursework are the five CHEMENG core courses, three quarters of CHEMENG 699 colloquium, two CHEMENG 400-level courses, 9 units of graduate science and engineering lecture electives from any department and 6 units of flexible elective courses (not research, rotation or teaching units), inside 135 graduate units that include your research. You also need two quarters of CHEMENG 601 teaching. Every course must be letter graded when a letter grade is offered. You check by hand the research rotations and advisor match, the third-year poster, the reading committee, the candidacy exam and application, the 3.0 GPA (needed by the end of your first year and kept throughout), the oral exam, the dissertation and your advisor and Graduate Committee's approval of your coursework.
